author: Richie Mills
title: Colton Nussmeier impresses in his Archbishop Rummel debut - NewsBreak
text:
By Richie Mills ,
35 minutes ago
METAIRIE, La. — Colton Nussmeier made his Archbishop Rummel debut Wednesday when the Raiders faced Ponchatoula in their annual scrimmage.
The 4-star quarterback only appeared in two eight-play series, but both ended in the end zone.
Nussmeier completed six of his eight pass attempts with one touchdown against the Green Wave. 35-yard and 20-yard completions set up a 15-yard touchdown run by Coryan Hawkins.
Nussmeier's second and final drive of the night would end with a 20-yard touchdown connection with junior wide receiver Kirby Cade Jr. who finished with two touchdowns.
It was an impressive showing for a Georgia-commit who transferred to Rummel earlier this month.
"It's been hard, you know, learning the offense in a short period of time. But you know, I've got to do it. I've got to be a quarterback. I've got to be a leader. And I've gotta go out there and execute," said Nussmeier.
Nussmeier says his support system has helped the 6'4, 210-pound quarterback navigate these uncharted waters.
It helps a lot because, you know, I got my brother, my dad and my close circle to help me with whatever I need. I've had to learn a good amount of playbooks, you know, coaches leaving and all that, but, you know, just doing it faster. It's just hard. But you know, you got to do it," Nussmeier added.
Rummel is back in action next Friday, August 28th, when they face St. Paul's in their jamboree.
